fact: The presidency says the e-Senegal one-stop portal, launched on 24 March 2026 by Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko, is operational and lets citizens complete passport applications, business creation, police clearance certificates and certificates of nationality online.

The Interior Ministry's directorate of territorial administration (DGAT) invited all NGOs and associations to register on the new e-OSC platform, saying registration prepares the progressive online handling of NGO approval and association recognition requests.
Polygon says the Service Public portal of Senegal lists nearly 700 administrative procedures available online, as a single window for information and forms.

Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko presented the single citizen window (guichet unique du citoyen), through which users would apply for and follow public services remotely, and announced an online consular services platform, at the 24 March 2026 launch of New Deal technologique projects.

The World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) lists senegalservices.sn as Senegal's online public service portal, rated transactional (level 3 or 4); the line gives no other year, so the round's year is used.
